'''Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi''' (Japanese: '''水内清光''' ''Mizuuchi Kiyomitsu'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Mizuuchi was born on November 17, 1960, in {{wp|Osaka Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He started work on the {{pkmn|animated series}} with {{aniseries|SM}}, where he voiced recurring antagonist [[Viren]]. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
